items.title: آنچه گذشت؛ ترامپ:‌ در صورت پیشرفت مذاکرات، حملات جدید به ایران بسیار بعید است
items.summary: دونالد ترامپ، رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا، می‌گوید در صورت پیشرفت مذاکرات درباره برنامه هسته‌ای ایران و بازگشایی تنگه هرمز، احتمال این که ناچار شود دستور ازسرگیری جنگ با ایران را صادر کند، «بسیار بعید» است. عباس عراقچی، وزیر خارجه ایران هم پیش‌تر گفته بود که «پیشنهاد دو روزه» ایران برای باز شدن تنگه هرمز در صورت برآورده شدن شرایطش همچنان روی میز است و افزود کاخ سفید باید در این باره تصمیم بگیرد.

items.title: آنچه گذشت؛ قالیباف: اسرائیلی‌ها برای کشاندن آمریکا به جنگی بی‌پایان با ایران تلاش می‌کنند
items.summary: محمدباقر قالیباف، رئیس مجلس ایران و مذاکره کننده ارشد این کشور با آمریکا گفته است «اسرائیلی‌ها برای کشاندن آمریکا به جنگی بی‌پایان با ایران تلاش می‌کنند.» دونالد ترامپ می‌گوید که جنگ با ایران عملاً به پایان رسیده و افزوده است که از سرگیری حملات نظامی ایالات متحده «بسیار بعید» و غیرضروری است. آقای ترامپ پس از گفتگو با نخست‌وزیر قطر در کاخ سفید گفت که «روندی مثبت» به سوی دستیابی به توافقی برای پایان دادن به جنگ شکل گرفته است.

items.title: رضایی: هیچ مذاکره‌ای با آمریکا در جریان نیست
items.summary: محسن رضایی، دبیر شورای عالی امنیت ملی ایران، گفته است در حال حاضر هیچ مذاکره‌ای با آمریکا در جریان نیست. او گفته است که پیش از شروع مذاکرات، ایالات متحده باید به هفت شرط تعیین‌شده در تفاهم اسلام‌آباد عمل کند در غیر این صورت تنگه هرمز هم باز نخواهد شد. در خبری دیگر وزیر دفاع آمریکا می‌گوید تلاش برای استیضاح او در کنگره در رابطه با جنگ ایران اقدامی «مضحک» است که شکست خواهد خورد.

items.summary: به گفته پلیس بریتانیا، یک سرباز ارشد ارتش آمریکا روز سه شنبه در انگلیس به ظن جرایم جاسوسی مرتبط با روسیه دستگیر شد. به گفته پلیس متروپولیتن، مرد 41 ساله که هویتش فاش نشده است، در چارچوب تحقیقات در مورد تهدیدات مظنون به امنیت ملی که توسط پلیس مبارزه با تروریسم هدایت می شد، بازداشت شد. مقامات گفتند که این دستگیری با هماهنگی ارتش ایالات متحده و FBI انجام شده است. کش پاتل، مدیر اف‌بی‌آی در بیانیه‌ای گفت: این دستگیری مهم شامل اتهامات جاسوسی است که برای ایالات متحده و متحدان ما بسیار نگران کننده است. FBI برای مامور سابق اطلاعات نیروی هوایی متهم به جاسوسی برای ایران 200 هزار دلار جایزه می دهد.
items.summary_original: A senior U.S. Army soldier was arrested in England Tuesday on suspicion of espionage offenses related to Russia, according to U.K. police. The 41-year-old man, whose identity was not released, was detained as part of an investigation into suspected national security threats led by Counter Terrorism Policing , according to the Metropolitan Police. Officials said the arrest was carried out in coordination with the U.S. military and the FBI. "This important arrest involves allegations of espionage, which is of the utmost concern to the United States and our allies," FBI Director Kash Patel said in a statement. FBI OFFERS $200K REWARD FOR FORMER AIR FORCE INTELLIGENCE AGENT ACCUSED OF SPYING FOR IRAN The soldier was arrested near Gloucester, and police are currently searching two locations in the wider Gloucestershire area as part of the ongoing joint U.K.-U.S. investigation. Police said the man was detained under the National Security Act 2023 and remains in custody at a London police station. The investigation is ongoing and is being led by officers from the Counter Terrorism Policing team in London. RUSSIAN SPIES ORCHESTRATED $40K MURDER PLOT IN NATION’S CAPITAL, US ALLEGES Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans, the senior national coordinator for Counter Terrorism Policing, described the allegations as "serious." items.summary: پیت هگزث، وزیر جنگ، روز سه شنبه از تلاش برای استیضاح عقب نشینی کرد و قانونگذاران را متهم کرد که می کوشند اختلافات بر سر سیاست های نظامی دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا را به جرایمی قابل استیضاح تبدیل کنند. کنگره در حال آماده شدن برای رای گیری در مورد هشت ماده است که ادعا می کند رئیس پنتاگون قوانین فدرال را نقض کرده و از اختیارات خود سوء استفاده کرده است. هگزت صبح روز سه شنبه در یک کنفرانس مطبوعاتی پنتاگون گفت: "یکی از نمایندگان ناراضی کنگره می خواهد آن را به خاطر اختلاف نظرهای سیاستی از بین ببرد. این چیزی است که وجود دارد: اختلاف نظر در سیاست، نه جنایات سنگین، نه جنایت، نه خیانت، نه رشوه، نه انواع تخلفاتی که بنیانگذاران هنگام نوشتن بند استیضاح قصد داشتند." او افزود: «راه حل مناسب برای اختلاف نظر در سیاست، قانون گذاری است، بحث است، این انتخابات ریاست جمهوری آینده است». اما استیضاح دوباره
items.summary_original: War Secretary Pete Hegseth pushed back against an impeachment effort Tuesday, accusing lawmakers of trying to turn disagreements over President Donald Trump's military policies into impeachable offenses. Congress is preparing to vote on eight articles alleging the Pentagon chief violated federal law and abused his authority. "One disgruntled congressman wants to shred it over policy disagreements. That's what it is: policy disagreements, not high crimes, not misdemeanors, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offenses the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause," Hegseth said at a Pentagon press conference Tuesday morning. "The proper remedy for a policy disagreement, it's legislation, it's debate, it's the next presidential election," he added. But the impeachment resolution introduced Monday by Rep. Thomas Massie, R-Ky., goes beyond objections to the administration's military strategy. It alleges that Hegseth violated congressional war powers, authorized unlawful military operations and retaliated against a sitting senator for exercising his constitutional rights. items.summary_original: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier announced Tuesday that his office issued an investigative subpoena to the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) to investigate whether the organization accepted contributions from "foreign sources of concern," including entities in Cuba and China. "Our laws prohibit accepting contributions from foreign sources of concern," Uthmeier said in a video statement. "We will not allow foreign adversaries to influence Florida through the backdoor of non-private fundraising." The subpoena demands documents related to recent DSA delegations to China and Cuba, where organization members met with Cuban government officials, to determine if the DSA violated Florida's Deceptive and Unfair Trade Practices Act, according to Uthmeier. DEMOCRATIC SOCIALISTS OF AMERICA ACTIVISTS SIGNED PLEDGE TO SUPPORT, DEFEND 'CHINESE SOCIALISM' Uthmeier did not detail specific criminal allegations or name individuals accused of violating state law. The DSA has repeatedly praised the Cuban regime and routinely advocates for lifting American sanctions and ending the U.S. embargo against Havana. RNC WARNS DEMOCRATS FACE 'POLITICAL SUICIDE' AFTER DSA PRAISES FIDEL CASTRO, DEMANDS RUBIO'S PROSECUTION The organization has sent multiple delegations to Cuba in recent years. items.summary_original: Iran's top security official, who reportedly received a letter from Vice President JD Vance about resuming peace talks, warned in a resurfaced interview that wartime negotiations with Tehran could drag on for decades, and during which both sides should "be prepared to fight." Mohsen Rezaei, a former commander of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), now serves as secretary of the Supreme National Security Council and acts as a key aide to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. He also helped shape Tehran's military strategy during the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq War . That eight-year conflict ended after Iran's then-supreme leader, Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, accepted a U.N.-brokered cease-fire that he famously likened to drinking from a "poisoned chalice." JD VANCE RETURNS TO WASHINGTON AFTER 16 HOURS OF IRAN PEACE TALKS COLLAPSE IN PAKISTAN "Ceasefire means an unfinished war," Rezaei had said of the war in a 2006 interview with the Iranian publication Baztab. An English translation of the interview is preserved by George Washington University's National Security Archive . Asked whether both sides would remain in their positions and begin talks, Rezaei replied: "Yes. Negotiations can take 30 to 40 years and during that time Iran and Iraq should be prepared to fight." Two decades after suggesting negotiations could drag on for years, Washington has reportedly been seeking talks with Rezaei, a key power player in Iran’s current military leadership. items.summary: علیرغم ناامیدی و صدای نارضایتی در میان برخی از قانونگذاران که از ضررهای ویرانگر میان دوره ای هفته گذشته متحمل شده بودند، در رهبری حزب جمهوری خواه مجلس سنا نه مهاجرت و نه خانه نشینی دسته جمعی رخ داد. رهبر اکثریت سنا، جان تون، R-S.D، یک دوره دیگر را به عنوان برترین جمهوری خواه پشت درهای بسته مجلس سنای قدیمی، جایی که قانونگذاران مسیر خود را برای چند هفته باقی مانده در قدرت و فراتر از آن تعیین کردند، به دست آورد. تون، همراه با اکثریت تیم رهبری خود، که اکنون شامل سناتور برنی مورنو از ایالت اوهایو است، پس از اینکه گروهی از جمهوری خواهان نتوانستند انتخابات رهبری را به تاخیر بیندازند، به سرعت انتخاب شدند. با این حال، بدون دعوا نبود، با مکالمات پشت درهای بسته که بیش از هفت ساعت به طول انجامید. سناتور جمهوری خواه حمایت از تون را متوقف می کند زیرا نمایش رهبری در حال رخ دادن است
items.summary_original: There was neither an exodus nor a mass housecleaning in the Senate GOP leadership, despite frustration and rumblings of discontent among some lawmakers reeling from last week’s devastating midterm losses. Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., secured another term as the top Republican behind the closed doors of the Old Senate Chamber, where lawmakers charted their course for their few remaining weeks in power and beyond. Thune, along with the bulk of his leadership team, which now includes Sen. Bernie Moreno, R-Ohio, were swiftly elected after a group of Republicans failed to delay the leadership elections. It wasn't without a fight, though, with conversations behind closed doors dragging on for over seven hours. GOP SENATOR WITHHOLDS SUPPORT FOR THUNE AS LEADERSHIP SHOWDOWN LOOMS Sen. Ron Johnson, R-Wis., led the charge to delay, and didn't stick around after his attempts to do so failed on a 31 to 15 vote in the Old Senate Chamber to proceed with the scheduled election. She also gave $1,250 to his Senate campaign committee, Friends of Bernie Sanders, in 2011. García's campaign took in $1,000 from Singham in August 2018, according to FEC records . items.summary: به گفته مقامات، شوهر یک مجری تلویزیون روز یکشنبه در پاکستان پس از اینکه جسد همسرش با شلیک گلوله به سرش پیدا شد، دستگیر شد. به گفته عظما زاهد بخاری، وزیر اطلاعات پنجاب، رابعه احسن، 41 ساله، ظاهراً در داخل خانه خود در راولپندی کشته شده است. احسن به عنوان مجری برنامه 92 نیوز مشغول به کار شد و در آنجا در کنار همکاران ارشد خود به عنوان یک روزنامه نگار متعهد شناخته شد. او همچنین به طور مکرر ویدیوهایی در مورد مسائل ملی در شبکه های اجتماعی منتشر می کرد. بخاری گفت که مقامات شوهر او را احسن طاهر خان شناسایی کردند که مدعی شد در خانه با سلاح گرم بازی می کرد که به طور تصادفی آن را تخلیه کرد. مجری محبوب تلویزیون، چهره‌های ستاره رسانه‌ای پس از محکومیت در پرونده عمده قاچاق مواد مخدر به دار آویخته شدند.
items.summary_original: The husband of a TV anchor was arrested in Pakistan Sunday after his wife was found dead with a gunshot wound to the head, according to officials. Rabiya Ahsan, 41, was allegedly killed inside her home in Rawalpindi, according to Punjab Information Minister Azma Zahid Bokhari. Ahsan worked as a program host for 92 News, where she established herself as a dedicated journalist alongside senior colleagues. She also frequently posted videos about national affairs on social media. Officials identified her husband as Ahsan Tahir Khan, who claimed he was playing with a firearm in the home when it accidentally discharged, Bokhari said. POPULAR TV HOST, MEDIA STAR FACES HANGING AFTER CONVICTION IN MAJOR SYNTHETIC DRUG TRAFFICKING CASE Khan reportedly works as a civil service officer at the Overseas Pakistanis Foundation, a government agency that supports citizens living abroad, according to local outlet The Express Tribune, citing police sources. Police are preparing to pursue a murder case against the suspect , according to the report. Rawalpindi police also confirmed in a post on X that a woman was killed in a Sunday shooting but did not immediately identify her. Authorities said officers seized the suspected weapon in connection with the husband's arrest. Ahsan's body was also transferred to a hospital for a postmortem examination. items.summary_original: Alaska's still too-close-to-call Senate race is expected to deliver another batch of ballot results Tuesday night after Monday's latest ballot drop expanded Democratic nominee Mary Peltola's lead over incumbent Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan to 2,517 first-choice votes. Still current as of Tuesday midday ET, Peltola stands at 48.6% (106,321 votes) to Sullivan’s 47.5% (103,804) in the ranked-choice voting system that will kick in if neither candidate gets across the 50% threshold. The controversial race, punctuated by the "Decoy Dan" scheme exposed by The New York Times, has Republican Gerald Heikes at 2.2% (4,865) and independent Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. at 1.7% (3,651 votes). Roughly 75–76% of the expected vote is in, with tens of thousands of early, absentee and questioned ballots still to be counted. "Mary won today’s votes by a margin of 68-30, reflecting major support in key areas from Anchorage and Chevak. items.summary_original: House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan , R-Ohio, will be President Donald Trump's top defender in Congress next year after winning a closed-door election for minority leader on Tuesday, sources told Fox News Digital. Jordan defeated Majority Leader Steve Scalise , R-La., currently the House of Representatives' No. 2 leader, in what's believed to be a narrow race. Jordan received 106 votes to Scalise’s 73, sources in the room told Fox News Digital. Fox News Digital heard loud, sustained applause from outside in the hallway when Jordan’s win became official. House Majority Whip Tom Emmer, R-Minn., also handily defeated Republican Study Committee Chairman August Pfluger, R-Texas, for the No. 2 leadership job of minority whip. The final vote count was 103 to 76, per sources. Sources said House GOP Conference Chairwoman Lisa McClain, R-Mich., meanwhile, also survived a challenge and kept her job. JORDAN EMERGES AS POTENTIAL NEXT GOP LEADER IF DEMS SEIZE HOUSE Republicans huddled for a candidate forum on Tuesday morning where all GOP lawmakers running for leadership positions were peppered with questions by their colleagues. Sources inside the room for their Tuesday morning leadership forum said Scalise and Jordan both pitched themselves as the best person to unify the conference, but also signaled they would give a wide berth for lawmakers to "vote their districts," as one person put it. items.summary_original: A newly elected Democratic socialist congressman from Philadelphia did not respond to questions about a boycott targeting Jewish-owned businesses in the city, even as prominent Pennsylvania Democrats condemned the demonstration, which coincided with the anniversary of Kristallnacht. Rep.-elect Christopher Rabb, D-Pa., who currently represents part of Northwest Philadelphia in the state House, did not respond to requests for comment about the boycott, which drew a large counterprotest supporting Jewish residents and businesses in Rittenhouse Square. A staff member at Rabb's Harrisburg office acknowledged Fox News Digital's inquiry and the two-hour deadline for a response. Fox News Digital also contacted Rabb's Harrisburg and campaign offices by email. TENSIONS FLARE AS DEMONSTRATORS TARGET JEWISH RESTAURANTS, DRAWING MASSIVE COUNTERPROTEST Over the weekend, the left-wing cycling group Philly Bike on Your Left helped organize a boycott targeting Jewish-owned businesses in Philadelphia's Rittenhouse Square neighborhood. Flyers promoting the rally carried the slogans "No business for Zionists" and "Not in our city," according to published reports. Philly Bike on Your Left could not immediately be reached for comment. Kristallnacht, or the Night of Broken Glass, refers to the November 1938 Nazi-organized attacks on Jews, synagogues and Jewish-owned businesses across Germany and Austria. items.summary_original: President Donald Trump isn't backing off his pressure campaign against Iran despite claims the conflict contributed to sweeping Republican losses in last week's midterm elections. In fact, Trump is doubling down by expanding U.S. efforts to choke off the trade routes Tehran increasingly relies on as it tries to rebuild its military in the midst of war. The new effort, dubbed Task Force Iron Gate, takes aim at a vulnerability that has persisted despite the U.S. naval blockade: the land and Caspian Sea routes Iran can use to bring in goods, dual-use technology and military supplies beyond the reach of American warships. That approach, one expert claims, fits into a broader administration strategy of tightening the squeeze on Tehran while stopping short of restarting full-scale military operations. Meanwhile, others caution that it could produce escalation rather than an immediate diplomatic breakthrough. IRAN VOWS ‘ASTONISHING’ STRIKES AND LIFTS MISSILE-RANGE LIMIT AS US TARGETS LAND ROUTES "We have Operation Iron Gate that just went into effect. That means nothing comes in by land," Trump said Sunday. But the roughly 20-person task force established at U.S. Central Command headquarters in Tampa is taking a quieter approach than Trump’s sweeping description might suggest. items.summary_original: A source in the office of a prominent nationally elected Democrat called "I've Had It" podcast host Jennifer Welch a "sicko" after she allegedly sought help managing backlash over a joke about digging up Charlie Kirk 's body. Welch denied the source's account as she and co-host Angie Sullivan renewed their attacks on Turning Point USA , with Sullivan telling the conservative organization to "f--- all the way off" despite the hosts' earlier apology. The controversy has also cost the podcast advertisers. Cash App announced it was ending its sponsorship, saying on social media: "We do not condone violence of any kind, and we are no longer sponsors of this podcast." Luxury bedding company Boll and Branch also reportedly dropped its sponsorship, while Turning Point USA's Andrew Kolvet claimed on X that several other advertisers had withdrawn their support. The hosts apologized over the weekend, but Sullivan subsequently told TPUSA to "f--- off" while Welch said her apology was motivated by her own convictions rather than pressure from the conservative organization. "Alright there's a huge online, cancellation campaign from all the titty babies over at Turning Point who want the 'I've Had It' podcast canceled," Welch said in a video posted to the podcast's YouTube channel. She accused Turning Point USA of "spearheading" the campaign because they're "losers and they lost" and "want to prove to their donors we can cancel libs." items.summary_original: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger's voting rights restoration effort is facing fresh scrutiny after a state letter indicating that voting rights had been restored was mailed in the name of a woman who remains incarcerated on a felony drug conviction. Spanberger and Secretary of the Commonwealth Candi Mundon-King have faced criticism over a series of apparent errors, including a letter sent to a dog in Goochland County that died five years ago, another sent to a sheriff’s office in Hampton Roads addressed to "Betty No Last Name" and others mailed to the families of deceased felons . A Virginia resident who requested anonymity contacted Del. Tom Garrett, R-Buckingham, after receiving a voting rights restoration letter addressed to "Kayla Renae Vaughn," a source told Fox News Digital. DEM AG'S ELECTION CRUSADE AGAINST TRUMP RUNS INTO EMBARRASSING DEAD-FELON BLUNDER BACK HOME Fox News Digital obtained images of the letter from the Republican minority caucus in the Virginia House of Delegates. The document appears identical to other restoration letters previously reported, except for the recipient's name. The resident has no known connection to Vaughn, according to the GOP caucus. Meanwhile, Vaughn remains in prison at the Central Virginia Correctional Unit in Chesterfield County, serving a 40-year sentence with 37 years suspended. items.summary_original: As Republicans reel from their bruising midterm election losses, Supreme Court Justice Sonia Sotomayor is hoping some of the court's biggest conservative rulings will eventually be overturned. Speaking at a weekend civics education event at George Washington's Mount Vernon estate, the liberal justice singled out the court's landmark 2024 presidential immunity ruling, which shields presidents from criminal prosecution for actions taken within their core constitutional powers and provides presumptive protection for other official acts. Her colleagues, Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas, are both in their late 70s, raising questions about their potential retirements and whether a Democratic-controlled Senate could complicate Trump's efforts to replace them with fellow conservatives. "We saw the outpouring of voters on Tuesday … I tell people all the time, there’s no excuse for not voting. There just isn’t. Apathy is not acceptable," Sotomayor said at TRUMP'S SUPREME COURT MAJORITY FACES LOOMING THREAT AFTER DEM SENATE TAKEOVER: 'STUCK' "I dissent a lot. I’m hoping that the court will take back some of the crazy things that it’s done. I’m only joking — maybe not," she said at the same event. "No, seriously. You know, I’ve spoken openly about this, there’s some opinions that I hope in my lifetime will get overturned. The immunity case is one of them." items.summary_original: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is quietly working towards a new goal: to become a progressive kingmaker in the burgeoning battle for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination. The socialist mayor of the nation's most populous city, who can't run for president himself because he's not a natural-born U.S. citizen, has been meeting behind closed doors with labor leaders to highlight the need for a union-aligned or left-wing candidate to seek the presidency. The mayor's moves come as he's reportedly said he's uncertain whether progressive champion Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez of New York, his close political ally, will run for the White House. According to Axios, which was first to report the news, Mamdani is concerned that if Ocasio-Cortez stays out of the 2028 race, it could leave progressives without a standard-bearer to face off against a more centrist presidential frontrunner in the primary battle. items.summary_original: Outgoing Sen. John Cornyn, R-Texas, has said that he met with Democratic Sen.-elect James Talarico in Washington, D.C., on Monday after previously meeting with him on Friday in Texas. "Good meeting with Senator-elect @jamestalarico today as he prepares to serve Texans in the U.S. Senate next Congress," Cornyn said in a post on X which features a photo of the two men shaking hands. Talarico also shared the photo in a post on X and commented on their meeting. TRUMP'S GAMBLE ON KEN PAXTON BACKFIRES AS DEMOCRAT PULLS OFF HISTORIC TEXAS SENATE UPSET "I just met with Senator John Cornyn. He has served our state honorably, and I’m grateful for his advice and guidance. Now is the time for us to come together — Democrats and Republicans — to deliver for Texas," Talarico wrote. Cornyn said that he thinks Talarico is "basically ... a good person," telling reporter Nicholas Ballasy on Monday that he "enjoyed meeting with" Talarico "last Friday in Austin and again this morning here in D.C." JAMES TALARICO BLAMES RISE IN GOP 'EXTREMISM' FOR PROMPTING HIS 'GOD IS NON-BINARY,' SIX SEXES REMARKS Talarico defeated Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton in the Lone Star State's 2026 U.S. Senate contest, becoming the first Democrat to win a Lone Star State U.S. Senate race in more than three decades. And the race was not even close — Talarico earned about 55% of the vote, while Paxton earned only about 43%, according to unofficial results. items.summary_original: A progressive organization urging Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez , D-N.Y., to run for president in 2028 has kicked off a campaign to collect signatures nationwide in support of the congresswoman's potential run. Ready for AOC, which describes itself as a "people-powered," "grassroots" and "unaffiliated" organization, launched the campaign Monday, urging supporters of the congresswoman to ask her to run for president. "Movements like this work when they're loud and early — long before the candidate says yes. The proof isn't money. It's names. Yours makes the case louder," the campaign's website states. WATCH: AOC LEAVES DOOR OPEN TO 2028 WHITE HOUSE BID: 'MAYBE, MAYBE NOT' The website boasts 804 signatures as of Tuesday morning, though representatives for the project claim to be aiming for 10,000 community leaders to join their mission, according to the New York Times. The group also claims to have 500 political and union leaders across 35 states on board, the outlet reported. "The goal is to build the infrastructure of a grassroots movement in the case that she decides to run, but also to demonstrate to her that, ‘Look, there is a movement behind you ready to power you to victory should you choose to run for president,'" Ravi Sahai, a spokesman for the group, told the New York Times. items.summary_original: Nvidia’s reported spy scandal is shaking markets and rattling the tech world, raising urgent questions about how close foreign agents can get to America’s most powerful corporate leaders. Dr. Michael Wallace, a professor at Tulane University and retired military intelligence officer with 20 years of experience, said foreign intelligence services study targets’ personal lives and interests to find ways to build trust and gain access. And it's become increasingly clear that business leaders worldwide could potentially provide access or information about the U.S. government if placed correctly. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was on Air Force One with President Donald Trump in May as part of the delegation during a summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Beijing. He has also visited the White House a handful of times to discuss the administration's artificial intelligence (AI) agenda and Nvidia's powerful chips and selling them to approved Chinese customers. HOW US CEOS QUIETLY TEAMED UP WITH TRUMP TO GAIN LEVERAGE OVER CHINA There are now active investigations into whether U.S. national security or company secrets were compromised by Huang’s reported extramarital affair with a businesswoman allegedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to target the Nvidia CEO. "The goal of human intelligence is to get somebody close to a source that can either elicit information or obtain information from a person," Wallace told Fox News Digital. items.summary_original: French President Emmanuel Macron is pushing ahead with plans for a new European military presence in Lebanon while struggling with mounting political and economic turmoil at home, even as the initiative encounters resistance from a key European partner and Washington considers an alternative that may not require troops. Secretary of State Marco Rubio confirmed that he had discussed the future of the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) with Macron, suggesting that a replacement monitoring mechanism could be civilian rather than military. "It doesn't have to be a military mission. It could be a civilian mission," Rubio said in remarks published Tuesday. Rubio explained that the administration is seeking a credible mechanism to verify arrangements under which Israeli forces withdraw from designated areas, the Lebanese Armed Forces (LAF) assume control and the Iran-backed terrorist group Hezbollah is prevented from returning. RUBIO ANNOUNCES FRAMEWORK DEAL BETWEEN ISRAEL AND LEBANON AS EXPERTS WARN IRAN WILL FIGHT TO SABOTAGE IT He suggested France could play a constructive role but emphasized that any arrangement would require agreement from both Lebanon and Israel. U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz also made clear that Washington has no intention of preserving the existing peacekeeping mission. "Probably, not necessarily," Trump said in a post-midterm election interview on CBS' "60 Minutes" when asked whether he will endorse in the primary to pick the next Republican nominee. "So I may or may not get involved... Maybe I'm better off not getting involved." Trump for months has touted the GOP's "great bench" when asked about the likely Republican field of contenders aiming to succeed him in the White House. The president reiterated that opinion after the GOP's drubbing in last week's midterm elections, as the party lost control of both the House and the Senate. VANCE, CRUZ, DESANTIS DIAGNOSE GOP'S MIDTERM DISASTER AS 2028 BATTLE BEGINS "I think we have an unbelievable bench of talent," Trump told Fox News' Bret Baier and Martha MacCallum in an election night interview on Fox News.. "We have a great group of talented people that I think would do a very good job." Early jockeying by the potential contenders began the morning after Election Day, with midterm post-mortems by Vice President JD Vance , Sen. Ted Cruz of Texas, and Florida Gov. items.summary_original: In addition to taking control of the House of Representatives, the Senate, and the majority of governorships on Tuesday, Democrats have also assumed control of the majority of state legislatures across the country for the first time in over a decade. Heading into the election, Republicans controlled 28 of the nation’s 49 bicameral state legislatures, compared with 18 controlled by Democrats, while three states had divided control. Democrats now control both chambers in 24 states, compared with 22 for Republicans. North Carolina and Texas have split legislatures, while races in Alaska and Georgia remain pending. Even if Republicans win the uncalled chambers in the pending states, Democrats will still control more state legislatures than Republicans. Nebraska is included in the Republican count because its officially nonpartisan, unicameral legislature is led by a Republican majority. Democrats scored major victories in several pivotal battleground states during the 2026 midterms , flipping legislative chambers and securing full control of state governments in places that will shape redistricting and election rules ahead of 2028. In Wisconsin, Democrats captured both the Assembly and Senate for the first time in years, pairing the wins with the governorship to create a trifecta. items.summary_original: FIRST ON FOX: The House Oversight Committee released a report concluding that prosecutorial failures, preferential treatment and institutional negligence allowed Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell to continue sexually exploiting young women and girls for years. The investigation, led by Chairman James Comer, R-Ky., raised concerns about potential conflicts of interest involving federal prosecutors, financial institutions that overlooked warning signs of sex trafficking and individuals accused of facilitating Epstein's abuse. The report identified two former federal prosecutors whose involvement in Epstein's original investigation raised potential conflicts of interest. Matthew Menchel, a senior federal prosecutor who recommended resolving Epstein's case through a non-prosecution agreement, previously had a romantic relationship with Lilly Ann Sanchez, who later represented Epstein. Menchel did not recuse himself from the investigation and continued communicating and meeting with Epstein after the agreement, according to documents cited by the committee. items.summary: فرماندار گاوین نیوسام که کالیفرنیا را مجدداً امضا کرده است، حداقل امتیاز 2 به 1 را از جمهوری خواهان مجلس کسب کرده است. کن کالورت، نماینده کالیفرنیا، پیش‌بینی می‌شود که نماینده یانگ کیم در کالیفرنیا، در رقابت‌های منطقه چهلمین کنگره که دوشنبه شب نامیده می‌شود، شکست دهد، و ظاهراً دو مقام کنونی را مجبور به مبارزه برای یک کرسی در این منطقه کرد. کیم در بیانیه‌ای که برای X ارسال شد، با انتقاد شدید از نقشه‌ای که عملاً یکی از آنها را بیرون کشید، نوشت: «می‌خواهم به نماینده کنگره به‌خاطر پیروزی‌اش به کن کالورت تبریک بگویم». من برای او بهترین ها را آرزو می کنم زیرا او به نمایندگی از جوامع ما ادامه می دهد. مایه تاسف است که طرح تقسیم بندی مجدد سیاسی گاوین نیوسام دو عضو جمهوری خواه کنگره را مجبور به این رقابت کرد. آمریکا آمدن موج آبی را دید - اما میزان آن را به شدت دست کم گرفت
items.summary_original: Gov. Gavin Newsom -signed California redistricting has scored at least a 2-for-1 consolidation of House Republicans. Rep. Ken Calvert, R-Calif., is projected to defeat fellow Rep. Young Kim, R-Calif., in the 40th Congressional District race called Monday night, ostensibly forcing two incumbents to battle for one seat in the gerrymandered district. "I want to congratulate Congressman Ken Calvert on his victory," Kim wrote in a statement posted to X, sharply criticizing the map that effectively drew one of them out. "I wish him the very best as he continues representing our communities. It is unfortunate that Gavin Newsom’s political redistricting scheme forced two Republican members of Congress into this race." AMERICA SAW THE BLUE WAVE COMING — BUT DRASTICALLY UNDERESTIMATED THE EXTENT OF THE DEM TSUNAMI All told, Democrats' redistricting and the so-called blue wave have more than cut the Republican California delegation in half, from nine seats (eight Republicans and one independent that caucuses with them) to just three or four (one race remains too close to call a week after the election). Calvert, the longest-serving Republican in California’s House delegation, had declared victory days earlier while ballots were still being counted. The district covers suburban communities in eastern Orange County and stretches into the Inland Empire in western Riverside County — southeast of Los Angeles. items.summary: سرعت راه رفتن می‌تواند سرنخ‌هایی مهم درباره سلامت جسمی و شناختی افراد در اختیار ما بگذارد. پژوهش‌ها نشان داده‌اند که کندتر راه رفتن فقط نشانه افزایش سن نیست، بلکه ممکن است با خطر بیشتر بیماری، افت عملکرد مغز و حتی کاهش امید به زندگی ارتباط داشته باشد. به گفته پژوهشگران، سرعت گام برداشتن بازتابی از عملکرد مجموعه‌ای از دستگاه‌های بدن، از مغز و اعصاب گرفته تا قلب، ریه‌ها، عضلات و استخوان‌هاست. به همین دلیل، برخی دانشمندان آن را یکی از ساده‌ترین و در عین حال موثرترین شاخص‌ها برای ارزیابی سلامت و روند پیری بدن می‌دانند.

items.summary: برای قرن‌ها، نام کولور با الماس گره خورده بود؛ روستایی در جنوب هند که بسیاری از مورخان آن را زادگاه احتمالی الماس افسانه‌ای «کوه نور» می‌دانند. اگرچه این روستا سال‌ها پیش زیر آب رفت، اما داستان آن هنوز پایان نیافته است. در حالی که بخش عمده کولور اکنون در آب‌های مخزن یک سد دفن شده، گروهی از مردم همچنان به این منطقه می‌آیند، زمین را می‌کاوند و شن‌ها را غربال می‌کنند؛ به این امید که شاید الماسی پیدا کنند که زندگی‌شان را برای همیشه تغییر دهد.

items.summary: ابوظبی، امارات متحده عربی — رئیس جمهور دونالد ترامپ، نخست وزیر قطر، شیخ محمد بن عبدالرحمن آل ثانی، روز دوشنبه در کاخ سفید در حالی که تلاش های دیپلماتیک برای پایان دادن به جنگ با ایران ادامه دارد، حتی در شرایطی که مارکو روبیو، وزیر امور خارجه هشدار داد که مذاکرات فاصله زیادی با پیشرفت دارد و تهران نشان می دهد که تمایل به مذاکره برای مذاکره بدون فشار دارد، دیدار کرد. پیام‌های رقابتی در حالی منتشر می‌شوند که تنگه هرمز همچنان منبع اصلی اختلالات اقتصادی جهانی است و دولت‌های منطقه برای راه‌حلی دیپلماتیک برای مناقشه‌ای که کشورهای خلیج‌فارس را در معرض هزاران حمله موشکی و پهپادی ایران قرار داده است، تلاش می‌کنند. روبیو روز یکشنبه قبل از عزیمت به نشست وزرای خارجه گروه 7 در پاریس در گفت و گو با خبرنگاران گفت: پیشرفت اندکی در مذاکرات و رد کردن آن صورت گرفته است.
items.summary_original: ABU DHABI, United Arab Emirates — President Donald Trump met Qatar's prime minister, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, on Monday at the White House as diplomatic efforts to end the war with Iran continue, even as Secretary of State Marco Rubio warns that negotiations remain far from a breakthrough and Tehran signals a willingness to negotiate without yielding to pressure. The competing messages come as the Strait of Hormuz remains a major source of global economic disruption and regional governments push for a diplomatic solution to a conflict that has subjected Gulf countries to thousands of Iranian missile and drone attacks . Speaking to reporters Sunday before departing for a G7 foreign ministers meeting in Paris, Rubio said there had been little progress in negotiations and rejected the terms put forward by Tehran. "I wouldn't say we're on the verge of a breakthrough," Rubio said. RUBIO DEFENDS TRUMP'S IRAN WAR AS NOT 'NECESSARILY POPULAR, BUT NECESSARY' He emphasized that Trump prefers a diplomatic settlement but described Iran's demands as unrealistic. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Monday that Tehran was prepared to negotiate an end to what he described as a prolonged state of neither war nor peace. items.summary: پلیس لهستان اعلام کرد مرد مسلحی که مظنون به قتل شش نفر در مرکز شهر کراکوف و همچنین پدر و مادر و خواهرش در خانه‌شان است، در بیمارستان جان باخته است. این مرد ۲۴ ساله روز شنبه، ۷ نوامبر، در مرکز شهر کراکوف، دومین شهر بزرگ لهستان، به روی مردم آتش گشود و کمتر از سه دقیقه پس از آغاز حمله هدف گلوله پلیس قرار گرفت. پلیس کراکوف گفت که او اوایل صبح دوشنبه در بیمارستان جان باخت. اما دو پلیسی که با مظنون تبادل آتش کردند به‌شدت زخمی شدند اما از مرگ نجات یافتند چون دو جراح بلافاصله به کمکش شتافتند.

items.title_original: Gunman who killed 6 in Poland's Krakow square dies in hospital after police shootout
items.summary: به گفته مقامات، مرد مسلحی که در تیراندازی در یک میدان شلوغ در لهستان شش نفر را کشت و 15 نفر را زخمی کرد، روز دوشنبه پس از شلیک پلیس در جریان این حمله جان باخت. مظنون 24 ساله از تیراندازی روز شنبه در کراکوف در شرایط وخیم در بیمارستان بستری بود و قبل از مرگ تحت چندین عمل جراحی قرار گرفت. دادستان لهستان تحقیقاتی را در مورد قتل و اقدام به قتل، از جمله حمله به افسران پلیس، به عنوان یک جرم تروریستی احتمالی آغاز کرده است. مقامات گفتند که فرد مسلح دارای دیدگاه های راست افراطی بود، اگرچه بازرسان به طور علنی انگیزه این حمله را مشخص نکرده اند. نوجوانی که کلاه ایمنی بر سر داشت، کارگر مدرسه لهستان را در میان ترس از حملات کپی‌برداری کشت، پلیس همچنین اجساد مادر، پدر و خواهر مظنون را در خانه خانواده کشف کرد.
items.summary_original: The gunman who killed six people and wounded 15 others in a shooting at a crowded square in Poland died Monday after being shot by police during the attack, authorities said. The 24-year-old suspect had been hospitalized in critical condition since Saturday's shooting in Krakow and underwent several operations before his death. Polish prosecutors have opened an investigation into the killings and attempted killings, including attacks on police officers, as a possible terrorist offense. Authorities said the gunman held far-right views , though investigators have not publicly established a motive for the attack. TEEN WEARING HELMET CAMERA KILLS WORKER AT POLISH SCHOOL AMID FEARS OF COPYCAT ATTACKS Police also discovered the bodies of the suspect's mother, father and sister at the family's home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, roughly 93 miles northeast of Krakow, per reporting from The Associated Press. The three are believed to have died from gunshot wounds, though authorities have not confirmed the circumstances of their deaths. The suspect, who was wearing military-style clothing and a bulletproof vest, drove into Krakow's historic Main Square on Saturday before opening fire, according to authorities. Four women and two men were killed, including a British man and an Austrian woman. Five foreign nationals were among the wounded. items.summary_original: President Donald Trump's push for a deal with Russia to end the war in Ukraine and potentially reshape European security has raised alarm among NATO allies, with a former top alliance commander warning Fox News Digital that President Vladimir Putin has long sought to divide the world into competing spheres of influence. The warning came as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also appeared to reject what he called a potential "Yalta 2.0," and NATO allies debated direct outreach to Putin ahead of delegations preparing for talks in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10-11. Retired Gen. Philip Breedlove , the former Supreme Allied Commander Europe, warned that Putin's ambitions extend far beyond Ukraine and reflect a broader vision for how global powers should divide influence. "Putin has a plan for the world, and he has pushed that plan on leaders several times," Breedlove warned before adding: "He talks about it and he writes about it." items.summary_original: Iran lifted its self-imposed ballistic missile-range limit and threatened to unleash new, homegrown weapons that would "astonish the entire world," within hours of the U.S. military launching a new task force aimed at choking off Tehran's weapons shipments and illicit trade Nov. 7. Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) spokesperson Brig. Gen. Hossein Mohebbi confirmed that Iran was now abandoning its previous 2,000-kilometer, or roughly 1,240-mile, ballistic missile-range restriction, according to The Associated Press . "That restriction has been lifted for us," Mohebbi clarified in the wake of the task force announcement. Rescue services are still working at the scene," MPK S.A., the city's municipal public transport company, wrote in a statement shared to X. items.title_original: Oil-rich UAE makes massive AI bet as Sam Altman unveils ambitious plan to transform energy industry
items.summary: ابوظبی، امارات متحده عربی — در افتتاحیه بزرگترین کنفرانس انرژی جهان در ابوظبی، هوش مصنوعی در کنار نفت و گاز در کانون توجه قرار گرفت زیرا سام آلتمن، مدیر عامل OpenAI به مقامات ارشد امارات متحده عربی برای اعلام همکاری بزرگی با هدف ورود هوش مصنوعی پیشرفته به صنعت انرژی پیوست. مراسم افتتاحیه ADIPEC 2026 با حضور فاکس نیوز دیجیتال، مقامات ارشد دولتی و رهبران صنعت انرژی را در زمانی گرد هم آورد که جنگ با ایران و اختلال در تنگه هرمز فشار فوق‌العاده‌ای بر عرضه جهانی انرژی وارد کرده است. اما در میان بحث در مورد تولید نفت، مسیرهای کشتیرانی و امنیت انرژی، دکتر سلطان الجابر، وزیر صنعت و فناوری پیشرفته امارات متحده عربی و مدیر اجرایی انرژی دولتی
items.summary_original: ABU DHABI, United Arab Emirates — At the opening of the world's largest energy conference in Abu Dhabi, artificial intelligence took center stage alongside oil and gas as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman joined senior UAE officials for the announcement of a major partnership aimed at bringing advanced AI into the energy industry. The opening ceremony of ADIPEC 2026, attended by Fox News Digital, brought together senior government officials and energy industry leaders at a time when the war involving Iran and disruptions to the Strait of Hormuz have placed extraordinary pressure on global energy supplies. But amid discussions about oil production, shipping routes and energy security, Dr. Sultan Al Jaber, the UAE’s minister of industry and advanced technology and chief executive of state-owned energy giant ADNOC, delivered a different challenge to the technology industry. And now, together, we will find out what AI can do for energy," Al Jaber told the audience, introducing a partnership between ADNOC, OpenAI and Abu Dhabi-based technology company G42. The announcement marked a significant step in the UAE’s ambition to become a global center for artificial intelligence, using its energy resources, financial strength and growing partnerships with American technology companies to help shape the industry’s future. items.title: ملانیا ترامپ از آتش بس اولشکی به عنوان "جرقه" بالقوه برای پیشرفت در بحبوحه جنگ اوکراین و روسیه استقبال کرد.
items.title_original: Melania Trump hails Oleshky ceasefire as potential ‘spark’ for progress amid Ukraine-Russia war
items.summary: بانوی اول ملانیا ترامپ و نمایندگان روسیه و اوکراین روز پنجشنبه از کاخ سفید صحبت کردند و از آتش بس در منطقه اولشکی تحت اشغال روسیه به عنوان یک "جرقه" بالقوه برای صلحی که فراتر از یک آتش بس موقت منطقه ای است، استقبال کردند. بانوی اول در کنفرانس خبری سه جانبه کاخ سفید با دو کشور متخاصم گفت: ما انسانیت را بر جنگ ترجیح داده ایم. "غیرقابل انکار، زندگی مردم بی گناه باید فراتر از تقسیم جنگ باشد. امیدوارم اولشکی الهام بخش صلح بیشتری باشد. هر تحول مهم با یک جرقه کوچک آغاز می شود." او افزود: «ما با هم می‌توانیم چیزی ماندگارتر از آتش‌بس موقت ایجاد کنیم. در داخل نقش دیپلماتیک مخفی ملانیا ترامپ در روسیه
items.summary_original: First lady Melania Trump and envoys from both Russia and Ukraine spoke from the White House on Thursday, hailing the ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Oleshky region as a potential "spark" for peace that lasts beyond a temporary regional ceasefire. "We have chosen humanity over war," the first lady said in a White House trilateral news conference with the two warring countries. "Undeniably, the lives of innocent people must transcend the division of war. I hope Oleshky inspires greater peace. Every significant transformation begins with a small spark." "Together, we can create something more enduring than a temporary ceasefire," she added, calling Oleshky "a spark in a world of darkness capable of illuminating the best in humanity." INSIDE MELANIA TRUMP'S SECRET DIPLOMATIC ROLE IN THE RUSSIA-UKRAINE CEASEFIRE DEAL Trump said she became aware of a humanitarian crisis in the region in September and directed her representative, Marc Beckman, to engage with Russia and Ukraine on her behalf. She said both countries agreed to work with her as an "exclusive intermediary" to establish a ceasefire in Oleshky and the surrounding Kherson region, deliver humanitarian aid and create a safe evacuation route for civilians. Her remarks were followed by comments from Russian special envoy Kirill Dmitriev , who said Russian President Vladimir Putin appreciated President Donald Trump’s efforts to stop the fighting. items.title: اعتراضات در سراسر فرانسه پس از فراخوان گروه های چپ برای بسیج آغاز شد
items.title_original: Protests erupt across France after left-wing groups call for mobilization
items.summary: فرانسه روز پنجشنبه 70000 افسر پلیس را در حالی مستقر کرد که ده‌ها هزار نفر پس از فراخوان گروه‌های چپ برای بسیج به خیابان‌ها برای اعتصابات و تظاهرات سراسری آمدند. در پاریس، برج ایفل بسته شد. در لیون، پلیس ضد شورش فرانسه گاز اشک آور پرتاب کرد و گروهی از معترضان را متهم کرد. به گزارش رویترز، یک دبیرستان در نزدیکی تولوز به آتش کشیده شد. این خبرگزاری به نقل از سوفی بینه، رئیس اتحادیه چپگرای CGT، گفت: «ما باید امروز به تعداد زیادی در خیابان ها حاضر شویم. این تظاهرات پس از آن برگزار شد که فرانسه در ماه اکتبر با اعتراضات خشونت آمیزی مواجه شد، امانوئل ماکرون، رئیس جمهور مستعفی فرانسه، "گروه های چپ افراطی که هدفشان سقوط جمهوری است" را مقصر دانست. مکرون فرانسه اعتراضات را به گردن گروه های افراطی چپ می اندازد که هدفشان سرنگونی ارتش است
items.summary_original: France deployed 70,000 police officers Thursday as tens of thousands of people took to the streets for nationwide strikes and protests after left-wing groups called for a mobilization. In Paris, the Eiffel Tower was closed; in Lyon, French riot police fired tear gas and charged a group of protesters; and near Toulouse, a high school was set on fire, according to Reuters. "We need to turn up in big numbers on the streets today," the news agency quoted the head of the left-wing CGT union Sophie Binet as saying. The demonstrations come after France was rocked by violent protests in October, which outgoing French President Emmanuel Macron blamed on "ultra-left groups whose aim is to bring down the Republic." FRANCE'S MACRON BLAMES PROTESTS ON 'ULTRA-LEFT GROUPS WHOSE AIM IS TO BRING DOWN THE REPUBLIC' An official close to Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said that by early Thursday, around 270,000 people had joined the union action in 180 rallies outside the capital. About a third of France’s high schools were closed or unable to operate, some because of student blockades and others because teachers were on strike, The Associated Press reported. Toby Harris, an Australian tourist who was visiting Paris on Thursday, told Fox News Digital that "I feel like it's probably a good thing that there's like political action in the city. items.title_original: Multiple flights in Europe diverted because of bomb threats
items.summary: چندین هواپیما در سرتاسر اروپا روز پنجشنبه به دلیل تهدیدهای بمب گذاری که بی اساس بودند منحرف شدند و مجبور به فرود اضطراری شدند. حداقل 11 هواپیما از شهرهایی از جمله کپنهاگ، دوبلین، هلسینکی، مادرید، میلان و ورشو آسیب دیده اند. منبع تهدیدات بلافاصله مشخص نشد. این حوادث پس از آن رخ داد که چندین پرواز در اروپا در روز سه‌شنبه هشدارهای مشابهی دریافت کردند که دولت بریتانیا آن را "تهدیدهای جعلی بدخواهانه" توصیف کرد. پلیس چک پیش از این که بازرسی های هواپیما را بازرسی کرد، نوشت: "با دریافت تهدیدی مبنی بر قرار دادن یک بمب دست ساز در 4 هواپیمای عازم پراگ، به همراه همکاران فرودگاه پراگ برای فرود آنها آماده می شویم. ما ارتباط تهدیدات را کم ارزیابی می کنیم."
items.summary_original: Multiple planes across Europe were diverted and forced to make emergency landings Thursday because of bomb threats that have turned out to be unfounded. At least 11 planes, originating from cities including Copenhagen, Dublin, Helsinki, Madrid, Milan and Warsaw, have been affected. The source of the threats was not immediately clear. These incidents came after several flights in Europe received similar warnings on Tuesday that the U.K. government described as "malicious hoax threats." "Upon receiving a threat regarding the placement of an improvised explosive device on board 4 aircraft heading to Prague, we are preparing with colleagues from Prague Airport for their landing. We assess the relevance of the threats as low," Czech Police wrote on X, before adding that inspections of the planes yielded "negative results." The threats come at a time when European officials have been blaming Russia and Iran for "hybrid attacks" and acts of sabotage, which both Moscow and Tehran deny, Reuters reported. That flight landed safely at the base in Evreux in Normandy, with all 151 passengers and six crew members disembarking, the office said. items.summary: مقامات نظامی ژاپن اعلام کردند که یک تفنگدار آمریکایی روز سه شنبه پس از یک حادثه در حین تمرین در کمپ شواب در اوکیناوا ژاپن جان باخت. این حادثه در اوکیناوا، در یک پایگاه تفنگداران دریایی در نزدیکی ساحل شمال شرقی استان اوکیناوا رخ داد. تفنگدار دریایی که با نام لنس سی پی ال ​​شناسایی شد. دوین جی. هرناندز، 25 ساله، از مریلند، با لشکر سوم دریایی بود. قتل ادعایی توسط تفنگداران دریایی ارتش ایالات متحده را وادار می کند که آزادی خارج از پایگاه در اوکیناوا را محدود کنند. ما عمیق ترین تسلیت خود را به خانواده و عزیزان تفنگدار دریایی خود ابراز می کنیم. هرناندز در تمرینات طناب زنی سریع در کمپ شواب شرکت می کرد
items.summary_original: A U.S. Marine died Tuesday after an incident during training at Camp Schwab in Okinawa, Japan, military officials said. The incident happened in Okinawa, on a Marine Corps base near the northeastern coast of Okinawa Prefecture. The Marine, who was identified as Lance Cpl. Devin J. Hernandez, 25, of Maryland, was with the 3rd Marine Division. ALLEGED KILLING BY MARINE PROMPTS US MILITARY TO RESTRICT OFF-BASE LIBERTY IN OKINAWA "It is with heavy hearts that 3rd Marine Division announces the death of a Marine following a training incident at Camp Schwab, Okinawa, Japan, on Nov. 3, 2026," the 3rd Marine Division said in a press release. "We express our deepest condolences to the family and loved ones of our Marine." Hernandez was participating in fast-rope training at Camp Schwab when he sustained injuries during the training, the 3rd Marine Division said in a later statement to Fox News Digital. He was transported to a hospital and later succumbed to his injuries. "A Marine currently assigned to 3rd Marine Division was involved in a fast rope training incident at Camp Schwab on Nov. 3, 2026. The Marine was later declared deceased at the U.S. Naval Hospital, Camp Foster. The Marines and Sailors of 3rd Marine Division are deeply saddened by this loss," 1st Lt. Hannah Ladd said in a statement to Fox News Digital. The Marine's death remains under investigation, the 3rd Marine Division said. items.title_original: Canadian mother and daughter dead after suspected grizzly bear attack on hiking trail
items.summary: به گفته مقامات، یک زن کانادایی و دخترش در یک حمله مشکوک خرس گریزلی در آخر هفته هنگام پیاده روی در مسیری نزدیک خانه خود کشته شدند. جنیفر بالکاراس، 48 ساله، هنردرمانگر، و دخترش، سله رید، 20 ساله، روز شنبه پس از رفتن به پیاده روی در مسیر Snooka West Trail، تنها چند دقیقه از خانه خود در بلا کولا، بریتیش کلمبیا، ناپدید شدند. برادرش مت بالکاراس به The Vancouver Sun گفت که وقتی بالکاراس در یک جلسه آنلاین برنامه ریزی شده در روز شنبه حاضر نشد، عزیزان نگران شدند. راهنمای عملی برای اینکه خرس در تابستان امسال در حین پیاده‌روی یا کمپینگ مورد حمله قرار نگیرید پس از اینکه نتوانستند به این جفت برسند، بستگان از پلیس سواره سلطنتی کانادا (RCMP) خواستند تا یک بررسی رفاهی را در صبح یکشنبه انجام دهند. مقامات خودروی بالکاراس را که در آن پارک شده بود کشف کردند
items.summary_original: A Canadian woman and her daughter were killed in a suspected grizzly bear attack over the weekend while hiking on a trail near their home, according to authorities. Jennifer Balcarras, 48, an art therapist, and her daughter, Selah Reed, 20, went missing Saturday after going for a walk on the Snooka West Trail, just minutes from their home in Bella Coola, British Columbia . Loved ones grew concerned when Balcarras failed to show up for a scheduled online meet-up on Saturday, her brother, Matt Balcarras, told The Vancouver Sun . A PRACTICAL GUIDE TO NOT GETTING MAULED BY A BEAR WHILE HIKING OR CAMPING THIS SUMMER After failing to reach the pair, relatives asked the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) for a welfare check on Sunday morning. Authorities discovered Balcarras' vehicle parked at the trailhead . Her body was recovered Monday, and search teams found Reed's body on Tuesday. GRIZZLY BEAR MAULS HIKER, DRAGS HIM DOZENS OF FEET ON GLACIER NATIONAL PARK TRAIL "There was evidence to suggest a bear may have been involved," Jeff Tyre, an inspector with the British Columbia Conservation Officer Service, said in a video update posted to social media. Tyre noted that officers were actively working to "locate and capture any bears involved" and said it was not immediately clear if more than one animal was responsible. items.summary: پس از درهم شکستن باندهای جنایتکار قدرتمند در السالوادور، رئیس جمهور نایب بوکله توجه خود را به کشور هائیتی در دریای کارائیب معطوف کرد و 2000 سرباز را پس از ناپدید شدن چهار تکنسین هوانوردی نظامی سالوادور در پی کمین 18 اکتبر در نزدیکی پورتو پرنس مستقر کرد. بوکله در پیامی در شبکه X خطاب به گروه‌های جنایتکار هائیتی نوشت: «ما قبلاً کار با باندهای السالوادور را به پایان رسانده‌ایم و می‌توانیم با شما نیز کار را تمام کنیم. بوکله تاکید کرد که هدف از این عملیات، حمله به هائیتی یا انجام یک اشغال طولانی مدت نیست، بلکه بازیابی چهار ناپدید شده سالوادور زنده است. ناپدید شدن به یک اولویت ملی برای بوکله تبدیل شده است، او به رهبران باند هائیتی هشدار داده است که السالوادور آماده است تا اگر این افراد زنده بازگردانده نشوند، از نیروی عظیم استفاده کند. هیئت منصفه فلوریدا 4 من را محکوم کرد
items.summary_original: After crushing powerful criminal gangs in El Salvador, President Nayib Bukele has turned his attention to the Caribbean nation of Haiti, deploying 2,000 troops after four Salvadoran military aviation technicians disappeared following an Oct.18 ambush near Port-au-Prince. "We have already finished with the gangs in El Salvador, and we can finish with you too," Bukele wrote in a message on X directed at Haiti's criminal groups. Bukele stressed that the operation's objective was not to invade Haiti or conduct a long-term occupation, but to recover the four missing Salvadorans alive. The disappearance has become a national priority for Bukele, who has warned Haitian gang leaders that El Salvador is prepared to use overwhelming force if the men are not returned alive. FLORIDA JURY CONVICTS 4 MEN WHO PLOTTED ASSASSINATION OF HAITI'S PRESIDENT FROM SOUTH FLORIDA HUB The aviation technicians were assigned to a medical unit as part of the United Nations -backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF) in Haiti when their armored vehicle was attacked in Croix-des-Bouquets. Haiti’s National Police announced Tuesday, more than two weeks after the attack, that it had found the charred remains of the vehicle in the Santo neighborhood of Croix-des-Bouquets. Police said, however, they found no sign of the missing men. El Salvador says the men were abducted, the Haitian government says the soldiers are missing, and one gang leader says they are dead. items.summary_original: TEL AVIV, Israel: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s hold on power in Israel will be tested Wednesday as President Isaac Herzog begins consultations with leaders of all parties elected to the 26th Knesset before deciding which lawmaker to task with forming the next government. The final vote count, published last Friday by Israel's Central Elections Committee, gave Netanyahu's bloc 53 seats in the 120-member Knesset, compared with 48 for the opposition alliance led by Gadi Eisenkot — 61 seats are needed to form a government. On Monday, Netanyahu posted to X that "the public in Israel does not want a government that depends on Ra'am and the Joint List—parties that support terrorism and reject the existence of the Jewish state." NETANYAHU DEFIES EXIT POLLS AS VOTE SHIFTS IN HIS FAVOR, BUT MAJORITY REMAINS ELUSIVE "A clear majority in the Jewish public chose the Likud as the largest party and me, as prime minister, to lead the next government. We aspire to form a broad government with our partners and with any party that wishes to do so and does not support terrorism. I am open to holding discussions on the matter," he added. The two predominantly Arab parties he pointed his criticism at are the Joint List and Ra'am who secured a historic combined total of 19 seats, potentially positioning them as kingmakers in the government formation process. items.summary_original: KYIV, Ukraine — Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is defying calls from the Trump administration for his armed forces to stop attacking Russian oil refineries, telling Fox News: "Our response must be painful." In an interview in Kyiv, Zelenskyy acknowledged holding discussions with the Trump administration about targeting oil facilities, attacks President Donald Trump has pinned as being partly to blame for high gas prices in the U.S. "We had different conversations — different, and several — with President Trump and with his team about attacks on refineries," Zelenskyy said. "We said that if you want us not to attack Russia's refineries, they have not to attack our energy system." TRUMP TELLS ZELENSKYY TO STOP DOING 'ONE THING' DURING ATTACKS ON RUSSIA Ukraine has reported near-daily Russian strikes on energy infrastructure , triggering power outages just as temperatures dip ahead of winter. "That's why we have to respond. But our response has to be painful for Russian military people," Zelenskyy said. "If we will not respond on energy, they will continue." U.S.-Ukraine relations took a further hit in October when Trump struck a deal to import millions of tons of Russian diesel to the United States. items.summary_original: U.S. officials will mediate a new round of talks between Ukraine and Russia next week with the goal of delivering "lasting security for generations to come," U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff said on Monday. Witkoff said the U.S.-mediated negotiations will be held on Nov. 10 and 11 in Abu Dhabi in the United Arab Emirates. "The United States will mediate working-level negotiations between Ukraine and Russia on November 10–11 in Abu Dhabi, advancing President Trump’s mission to end the war. Discussions will focus on post-war security arrangements, de-escalation, humanitarian efforts, and next steps toward peace," Witkoff wrote on X. "Additionally, American negotiators will meet this week in Brussels with representatives from France, Germany, the United Kingdom, the EU, and NATO to discuss security guarantees for Ukraine, Europe’s post-war security architecture, and economic opportunities to support Ukraine’s reconstruction," Witkoff said. The Ukrainian leader's warning came as voters prepared to decide which party controls Congress, a result that could also influence Washington's future response to Russian President Vladimir Putin's almost five-year war in Ukraine. In a post on X, Zelenskyy went on to urge the Trump administration to increase pressure on Moscow, warning that Russia could exploit the elections to target Ukraine's battered energy infrastructure and supply routes. "The assumption is basically that tomorrow the world will be watching the American midterms, and what is happening here in Ukraine, along with our difficulties with air defense and Patriot missiles, will be overlooked." Zelenskyy's warning came hours after Russian forces struck a school being used to distribute humanitarian aid in Komyshuvakha, a settlement in southeastern Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region. items.summary_original: Friday’s late-night confrontation at Poland's Constitutional Tribunal, which drew riot police and protesters and prompted President Karol Nawrocki to turn his plane around and return to Warsaw, has reignited a bitter debate over whether Prime Minister Donald Tusk is restoring the rule of law or overstepping constitutional limits. The dispute erupted after the tribunal announced the suspension of its president, Bogdan Święczkowski, a move that supporters of Tusk’s government described as necessary to restore judicial independence, while critics denounced it as an unconstitutional power grab. Marcin Przydacz, the head of the International Policy Bureau in Nawrocki’s office, took to European TV Monday morning denouncing Tusk’s actions, saying, "Even lawyers who are close to the Tusk government say that there's absolutely no legal basis for such behavior." POLISH PRESIDENT TURNS PLANE AROUND AFTER 'COUP' AT NATION’S TOP COURT The dispute is also triggering diplomatic fallout, with at least three Polish ambassadors resigning in protest. Przydacz, a former parliament member of the now-opposition Law and Justice (PiS) party, says Poland’s permanent representative to the U.N. since 2021, Krzysztof Szczerski, resigned Monday, which followed the resignations over the weekend of the ambassadors to China and Romania. items.summary_original: Ukraine officials said the country’s official air-raid alert app was likely hacked after emergency alerts warned on Sunday that there was a "radiation hazard" and a "chemical attack alert" in Kyiv. The false warnings urged residents not to go outside. "There is a radiation hazard alert in Kyiv. Do not go outside!" read one alert. RUSSIA LAUNCHES BALLISTIC MISSILE ATTACK ON KYIV HOURS AFTER ZELENSKYY WARNS OF MAJOR STRIKE "There is a chemical attack alert in Kyiv. Do not go outside!" another one read. The public air alert online map also displayed Kyiv and other areas as under a nuclear alert. The app also issued false warnings about Russia’s hypersonic Oreshnik missile and alleged street fighting in Kyiv. Additionally, loudspeakers in the streets blasted a recorded message instructing people to take precautions. But Ukraine’s Air Force said its air alert app was hacked and that there was no radiation hazard to be concerned about. "The air alert app appears to have been subjected to enemy influence. There is no radiation threat! Stay calm and follow our updates on our channel!" the Ukrainian Air Force said in a statement posted to Telegram. Ukraine’s Center for Strategic Communications blamed Russia for the incident, although no group had publicly claimed responsibility.
